claim: A kSectorZMotionSprite sector (type 602) moves only the sprites standing in it that carry cstat 8192 (moved with the floor's on/off z) or 16384 (with the ceiling's); its own floor and ceiling do not travel (at load trInit sets them once to the saved state's off or on z). It is how Blood raises bars or a portcullis while the ground under them stays put.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:1209 VSpriteBusy: only sprites with cstat&8192 / cstat&16384 get a new z; no floorz/ceilingz is written; trInit :2247-2249 calls ZTranslateSector (:1023) for 602 once at load
E3M3 s254: type 602, off floor 141312 (its saved floor), on floor 118784, rx 129 -- E3M3's portcullis (its sprite 198, tile 1044 'grate', cstat 8337)
E3M3 s254's channel 129 is sent by two lever switches of tile 1070 (sprites 199 and 201, type 20), not by the wheel sprite 107 (tile 982, which sends 124 to Z sector s94)
use: For bars, grilles or a gate that lifts out of a fixed floor, use type 602 with the bar sprites flagged 8192; use type 600 only when the floor itself should move.

checked.how: triggers.cpp:1209 VSpriteBusy: sprites with cstat&8192 take baseSprite z + dz1 (floor on-off), cstat&16384 dz2 (ceiling); no floorz/ceilingz written. But trInit :2247-2249 runs ZTranslateSector (:1023, :1042) on 602 too, setting the floor to its saved state's off/on z at load. E3M3 s254: 602, floor 141312 = off, on 118784, rx 129; sprite 198 tile 1044 (owner 'grate') cstat 8337 (8192 set); sprites 199, 201 type 20 tile 1070 tx 129; sprite 107 tile 982 (unnamed; read as a cart wheel) tx 124 to s94 (type 600).
